current_answer: As of September 27, 2026, Grand Theft Auto VI remains committed to November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar, Take-Two, Xbox, PlayStation, and the checked Store surfaces still converge on that console date; PlayStation listings label the game PS5 Pro Enhanced but publish no performance requirement. Rockstar’s September 24 Goodtime State collection is a real launch product due November 19, but the game is sold separately; it adds launch coordination, not proof of a finished build. PC still has no official platform or date in the checked source set.

catalogue_card.question: Is GTA 6 still on for November 19?
catalogue_card.text: Yes on the current official record: the November 19, 2026 console commitment remains live. Rockstar’s new Goodtime State collection arrives the same day but sells the game separately; that is launch collateral, not proof the date is unchangeable. PC remains unannounced.

summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Rockstar opened pre-orders for The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection for November 19; the official announcement says Grand Theft Auto VI is sold separately, so the product adds launch coordination but not software-readiness evidence.
The US and New Zealand PlayStation Store pages still show their digital PS5 timestamps; PlayStation labels the game PS5 Pro Enhanced, but does not publish a Pro performance target or requirement.
Rockstar Support still lists November 12 preload and a code-in-box physical version; soundtrack, accessory, and merchandise campaigns remain launch activity, not a guarantee.
Take-Two’s general PC comments and fresh editorial coverage supply no official GTA VI PC platform, date, or window.
A September 20 report about old rough GTA VI map material is unofficial historical context, not evidence of a current build or schedule change.
uncertainty: An official commitment is not a guarantee; two earlier official date movements remain in the record.
PlayStation Store timestamps are operational metadata for digital PS5 listings and may change; they do not establish Xbox timing.
PS5 Pro Enhanced is an official label, but no checked source publishes a performance target or says Pro ownership is required.
The Goodtime State collection is launch merchandise with the game sold separately; it supports campaign coordination, not software readiness or an immutable date.
Take-Two’s PC comments, editorial forecasts, and community discussion do not create an official PC platform, date, or window.
The old archive report concerns rough early material and supplies no current schedule evidence; no first-party pool analytics or revenue signal exists.
